review.notes: No code fences in the OCR and the heading list matches the PDF's numbered sections; no spurious figure-banner or page-break headings found. Full-page normalized diff of PDF text against the OCR markdown for all 40 physical pages: every unmatched window resolved as a running header, figure-internal chart/axis/legend text (Figures 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11), table-cell flow, or LaTeX-equivalent math (equations 1-8 including the length-control weights); all suspected prose (23.5 trillion-token split, OpenHands harness, KernelBook, GenSelect, length-control rationale, MMLU-redux Professional Accounting 64.00->77.00) is present. Tables 1-6 spot-checked against the PDF text layer and are complete; contributor and reference sections are present (diff misses were line-wrap artifacts). Rendered and visually inspected pages 1, 2, 3, 9, 11, 14, 23, 24: the PDF prints the Hugging-Face emoji (OCR wrote a different smiling emoji), 'SDK configs folder' (OCR dropped the 's' twice), the superscript on physical p.11 is 5 (OCR wrote 4), and all 16 footnote bodies at page bottoms were transcribed from the renders and inserted after the OCR paragraph or list containing the matching markers, following the established footnote-restoration format.
